title: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
claim: Show HN: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
why_good: This project addresses a common pain point for remote workers who need their laptops to stay awake during long tasks without unnecessary power consumption.
value: Companies could pay for a subscription model to ensure their employees can optimize their devices for productivity, especially in remote work settings.
risk: The feature could be easily replicated by existing operating systems or productivity tools, making it difficult to establish a sustainable business.
